paper.title: Neural Oscillations Carry Speech Rhythm through to Comprehension

thesis: Together, the reviewed evidence suggests that low-frequency oscillations in the acoustic speech signal form the foundation of a rhythmic hierarchy supporting spoken language, mirrored by phase-locked oscillations in the human brain.
